entries.label: The United States vs. itself
entries.summary: The 2024 election strains US democracy more than at any time in 150 years.
entries.quote: The 2024 election will test American democracy to a degree the nation hasn't experienced in 150 years.

entries.label: Middle East on the brink
entries.summary: Many armed actors make escalation of the Gaza war into a wider regional war likely.
entries.quote: The region is a tinderbox, and the number of players carrying matches makes the risk of escalation exceptionally high.

entries.label: Partitioned Ukraine
entries.summary: Ukraine becomes divided in practice, against the wishes of Kyiv and the West.
entries.quote: Ukraine will be de facto partitioned this year, an unacceptable outcome for Ukraine and the West that will nevertheless become reality.

entries.label: Ungoverned AI
entries.summary: AI advances outpace efforts to govern them.
entries.quote: Breakthroughs in artificial intelligence will move much faster than governance efforts.

entries.label: Axis of rogues
entries.summary: Russia, Iran and North Korea cooperate more closely and threaten stability.
entries.quote: Deeper alignment and mutual support between Russia, Iran, and North Korea will pose a growing threat to global stability.

entries.label: No China recovery
entries.summary: China's economy fails to rebound durably despite brief signs of improvement.
entries.quote: Any green shoots in the Chinese economy will only raise false hopes of a recovery as economic constraints and political dynamics prevent a durable growth rebound.

entries.label: The fight for critical minerals
entries.summary: Industrial policy and trade restrictions intensify competition for critical minerals.
entries.quote: The scramble for critical minerals will heat up as importers and exporters intensify their use of industrial policies and trade restrictions.

entries.label: No room for error
entries.summary: The inflation shock from 2021 keeps dragging on economies and politics.
entries.quote: The global inflation shock that began in 2021 will continue to exert a powerful economic and political drag in 2024.

entries.label: El Nino is back
entries.summary: A strong El Nino brings extreme weather with food, water, health and political effects.
entries.quote: A powerful El Nino climate pattern will bring extreme weather events that cause food insecurity, increase water stress, disrupt logistics, spread disease, and fuel migration and political instability.

entries.label: Risky business
entries.summary: Companies caught in US culture wars lose autonomy and face higher costs.
entries.quote: Companies caught in the crossfire of US culture wars will see their decision-making autonomy limited and their cost of doing business rise.

entries.label: US-China crisis
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects comparatively stable US-China relations in 2024.
entries.quote: Yet we expect the US and China to maintain comparatively stable ties in 2024.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

entries.label: Populist takeover of European politics
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects Europe's political centre to hold.
entries.quote: But Europe's center will hold in 2024.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

entries.label: BRICS vs. G7
entries.summary: Eurasia Group does not expect the BRICS to become a China-led rival to the G7.
entries.quote: The BRICS will not emerge as a China-led rival to the G7 this year—or anytime soon.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.
